what_this_is: The pre-registered book's inception date, its autocorrelation bucket fixed from pre-inception data, and its append-only membership snapshots. Ships with inception = null: declaring inception is the project owner's decision and only makes sense once the Dormant manifest has entries (until then the only members would be the four Active registrations). See app/services/research_lab/book.py and BOOK_PREREGISTRATION.md.
